t: This Act may be cited as the “White Clay Creek Wild and Scenic Rivers System Act”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision that gives the Act its name. It sets up no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. One might assume a Wild and Scenic Rivers law involves state or local coordination, but nothing in this section's text provides for it.
